verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud infrastructure provider (on-demand instances, clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm), not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The community evidence describes an unofficial third-party MCP server that controls Lambda, which is the server role, not Lambda acting as an MCP client, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
